b: hi, I am running only cost cap campaign. usually, it shows ROAS 3.xx, some times 4.xx
after 2 months, frequency reached to 2, performance dropped to ROAS 2.xx for a week.. it definitely died I thought..

I stopped the campaign, and created bid cap with different ads. it did not show good performance. so I quit it too.. I did not have a enough time to create new creatives, so I turn on the old cost cap again, and it shows ROAS 4~6, 7 days straight until now maybe coincidence but I never seen anything like this stable results for a week..

the only thing that I changed was, I set up some bot traffic blocker for both the frontend and the backend. the results are amazing.. they catch about 4k~6k malicious bots a day. I developed my e-commerce site by myself from the scratch, and I have a lot more freedom to customize.

before I set the blocker, 30~40% of traffic from Meta ads were bots and it dropped to 8~12%. after a week, maybe pixel gets real human traffic or something and the performance wen up.. bot drop rate is 30%(12% from 30%), and ROAS increase rate is 30%(4 from 3, 6 from 4).. the ROAS increase almost same rate as the bot traffic drop rate..

I guess there is a relationship between bot rate and the performance maybe? what do you think..? I do not want to pay for shit bot traffic. after the Andromeda update or Meta is getting attacked by Chinese competitors or something I do not know but there are a lot of bots and that is trying to ruin Meta performance and I saw some posts in here asking people to move to tiktok or something.. there might be a war between social media platforms.. it is my theory but I dont know.
